source_instruction: i want to find a barstool made out of faux leather and stainless steel.  i want the one in black.
query: Oh man, I just spent 20 minutes trying to fix my wobbly ceiling fan this morning and I think I stripped a screw on the mount, plus my cat knocked over my favorite ceramic mug right as I was leaving to browse furniture so I’m already a little frazzled from running late. I saw a neighbor walking a super fluffy golden retriever puppy on my way over too, and I almost stopped to ask where they got it because it was so cute I could barely keep walking. Anyway, I’m looking for bar stools that are made with faux leather and stainless steel, specifically the black paired with stainless steel option, at a reasonable price.
